problem: Production locale readback timed out on the NL→EN pricing switch even though the target /en/prijzen route existed and the rest of the production deployment was exact.
root_cause: Public language anchors were intercepted and converted into imperative window.location navigation while mobile-menu handlers and DOM remounts operated on the same click. The i18n mount also attempted insertBefore with nested descendants, which could throw NotFoundError.
prevention: Public locale choices remain ordinary anchors and native browser navigation is authoritative.
The capture listener may persist locale preference and stop competing handlers, but must not prevent the anchor default action.
Dynamic language controls only insert before nodes that are direct children of their host.
Any i18n runtime change bumps the versioned asset URL to defeat stale CDN/browser caches.
